Interface Formatter<T>

Type Parameters:
T - 此 Formatter 格式化的对象类型
All Superinterfaces:
Parser<T>, Printer<T>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractNumberFormatter, CurrencyStyleFormatter, CurrencyUnitFormatter, DateFormatter, DurationFormatter, InstantFormatter, MonetaryAmountFormatter, NumberStyleFormatter, PercentStyleFormatter
public interface Formatter<T> extends Printer<T>, Parser<T>
格式化类型为 T 的对象。Formatter 既是对象类型的打印机也是解析器。
